sections.title: 3.1.1 Open Mode
sections.text_preview: The System shall provide the capability to operate in an Open Mode, within which authorized customers shall be allowed read-only access to requested Data Products. This is the nominal system mode.

sections.title: 3.1.2 Degraded System Mode
sections.text_preview: The System shall provide the capability to operate in a Degraded System Mode, within which the system generates a subset of products based upon priority and availability of system resources.

sections.title: 3.1.2.1 Degraded Data Notification
sections.text_preview: The System shall provide the capability to notify customers upon the NPOESS Ground System entering and leaving a Degraded Operations Mode.

sections.title: 3.1.3 Restricted Access Mode
sections.text_preview: The System shall provide the capability to operate in a Restricted Access Mode, within which only users meeting certain criteria will be authorized access to the data. Criteria will be defined in the

sections.title: 3.1.3.1 Restricted Access Notification
sections.text_preview: The System shall provide the capability to send an electronic notification to authorized users when they receive restricted access data.

sections.title: 3.2.1 Define Data Products
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of defining Data Products for Ingest.

sections.title: 3.2.2 Integrate System Elements
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of integrating System Elements including Scientific Algorithms, Product Tailoring Tools, Data Format Translation Tools, and other pre-defined transformation utilities.

sections.title: 3.2.3 Test Support
sections.text_preview: The System shall provide the capability to support functional and performance tests of system elements without impacting operational product generation.

sections.title: 3.2.4 Maintain Records of Data and System Elements
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of maintaining records of at least 30 days (configurable) worth of Ingest history.

sections.title: 3.2.5 Control Algorithm Execution
sections.text_preview: The System shall provide the capability to control the execution of Scientific Algorithms.

sections.title: 3.2.6 Data Product Generation
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of generating Data Products.

sections.title: 3.2.6.1 Data Product Priorities
sections.text_preview: The System shall provide the capability for an authorized user to adjust Product Generation priorities.

sections.title: 3.2.6.2 Platte Carre Projection
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of rendering Platte Carre projections.

sections.title: 3.2.6.3 Mercator Projection
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of rendering Mercator projections.

sections.title: 3.2.6.4 Polar Stereographic Projection
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of rendering Polar Stereographic projections.

sections.title: 3.2.6.5 Available Data Product Aggregations
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of aggregating Data Products up to and including one orbit.

sections.title: 3.2.6.6 Time-Averaged Data Products
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of producing time-averaged Data Products.

sections.title: 3.2.6.7 Available Grid Spacing
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of generating NOAA-Unique and Tailored Data Products with Government-specified grid spacing.

sections.title: 3.2.6.8 BUFR Data Format
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of reformatting Data Products into BUFR.

sections.title: 3.2.6.9 GRIB2 Data Format
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of reformatting Data Products into GRIB2.

sections.title: 3.2.6.10 GeoTIFF Data Format
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of reformatting Data Products into GeoTIFF.

sections.title: 3.2.6.11 HDF5 Data Format
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of reformatting Data Products into HDF5.

sections.title: 3.2.6.12 netCDF Data Format
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of reformatting Data Products into netCDF.

sections.title: 3.2.6.13 GZIP Compression Format
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of compressing Data Products with the GZIP algorithm.

sections.title: 3.2.6.14 ZIP Compression Format
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of compressing Data Products with the ZIP algorithm.

sections.title: 3.2.6.15 RICE Compression Format
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of compressing Data Products with the RICE algorithm.

sections.title: 3.2.6.16 JPEG Compression Format
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of compressing images of Data Products with the JPEG algorithm.

sections.title: 3.2.6.17 MPEG Compression Format
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of compressing animated images of Data Products with the MPEG algorithm.

sections.title: 3.2.6.18 Data Product Recovery
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of generating Data Products within a time frame not to exceed the maximum user-specified shelf-life of the Data Product.

sections.title: 3.2.7 Data Product Availability
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of making Data Products available to registered users.

sections.title: 3.2.7.1 User Subscription Requests
sections.text_preview: The System shall provide an online capability for registered users to request subscriptions to xDRs, Ancillary, NOAA-Unique, and Tailored Data Products.

sections.title: 3.2.7.2 Approve Subscription Requests
sections.text_preview: The System shall provide an online capability for the Government to approve subscription requests for xDRs, Ancillary, NOAA-Unique, and Tailored Data Products.

sections.title: 3.2.7.3 Archive NOAA-Unique Data Products
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of distributing NOAA-Unique Data Products to the CLASS Long-Term Archive (LTA).

sections.title: 3.2.7.3.1 Provide Manifest and File Reports to CLASS
sections.text_preview: The System shall provide a list of files distributed to CLASS.

sections.title: 3.2.7.4 Receipt from CLASS
sections.text_preview: The System shall provide the capability to receive an electronic delivery acknowledgement message from CLASS.

sections.title: 3.2.8 Data Delivery
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of delivering NDE Data Products to registered user's computer systems.

sections.title: 3.2.9 Order Status Notification
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of notifying registered users of the status of their orders.

sections.title: 3.2.10 System Status Notification
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of notifying registered users of the status of the System.

sections.title: 3.2.11 Data Authorization Procedures
sections.text_preview: The System shall ensure that NDE information is accessible only to those authorized to have access.

sections.title: 3.2.12 Customer Registration
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of registering Users for the purpose of controlling their access to System Elements and Data Products.

sections.title: 3.2.13 Health and Status
sections.text_preview: The System shall provide a mechanism for reporting performance related to resource utilization, communications, product latencies, and hardware.

sections.title: 3.2.14 Provide Automatic Failover
sections.text_preview: The System shall provide an automatic failover capability that will re-create a fully functioning configuration from a failed configuration.

sections.title: 3.2.14.1 OPS Failover to Test
sections.text_preview: In the event of a failure of the Operational Environment during the NPOESS missions, the System Test Environment shall be capable of delivering products to the operational community within the same th

sections.title: 3.2.15 Monitor Input Data Integrity
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of monitoring the integrity of all data received from external sources.

sections.title: 3.2.15.1 Define Data Integrity Checks
sections.text_preview: The System shall provide the capability for an authorized user to define data input integrity checks.

sections.title: 3.2.15.2 Execute Data Integrity Checks
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of executing and recording the results of data input integrity checks, and initiate actions based on those results.

sections.title: 3.2.16 Data Product Latency
sections.text_preview:
The System shall be capable of making products available for distribution according to customer-

specified latencies.

sections.title: 3.2.17 Capture Performance Statistics
sections.text_preview: The System shall have the capability to monitor, record statistics, and deliver reports on its performance.

sections.title: 3.2.17.1 Performance Log Retention
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of retaining logs of all performance data for no less than 90 consecutive calendar days.

sections.title: 3.2.18 Generate Custom Reports
sections.text_preview: The System shall provide the capability to generate custom reports from data collected during data receipt, processing, and distribution.

sections.title: 3.3.1 Receive from IDPS
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of receiving data and products from IDPS.

sections.title: 3.3.1.1 xDR Ingest from IDPS
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of requesting and accepting all xDRs generated by the IDPS.

sections.title: 3.3.1.2 SARSAT Telemetry from IDPS
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of receiving SARSAT Telemetry from the IDPS.

sections.title: 3.3.1.3 A-DCS Data and Telemetry from IDPS
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of receiving A-DCS data and telemetry from the IDPS.

sections.title: 3.3.1.4 Product Subscriptions to the IDPS
sections.text_preview: The System shall provide an operator console capable of utilizing IDPS client software for submitting subscriptions for Data Products to the IDPS.

sections.title: 3.3.1.5 Ad Hoc Requests to the IDPS
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of automatically submitting Ad Hoc Requests to the IDPS for retransmission of Data Products.

sections.title: 3.3.1.6 Data Delivery Notifications
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of receiving Data Delivery Reports (DDRs) from the IDPS.

sections.title: 3.3.2 Ancillary Data Product Acquisition
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of receiving Ancillary Data Products from the Environmental Satellite Processing Center (ESPC).

sections.title: 3.3.3 Process Archived Data
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of ingesting and processing archived data.

sections.title: 3.3.4 Receive from CLASS
sections.text_preview: The System shall provide an operator console capable of requesting Data Products from the Comprehensive Large Array-data Stewardship System (CLASS).

sections.title: 3.3.4.1 Data Products from CLASS
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of receiving Data Products delivered from CLASS.

sections.title: 3.3.4.2 Send CLASS Data Receipt
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of sending a Data Receipt to CLASS for each Data Product received from CLASS.

sections.title: 3.3.5 MMC Interface Through ESPC
sections.text_preview: ESPC Operations shall provide an interface between NDE and the NPOESS Mission Management Center (MMC) such that 100% of the NDE inquiries to the MMC and NDE replies to MMC requests are received by the

sections.title: 3.3.6 NPOESS Trouble Ticket Interface
sections.text_preview: The System shall provide an operator console capable of interfacing with the NPOESS trouble ticketing system.

sections.title: 3.3.7 ESPC Trouble Ticket Interface
sections.text_preview: The System shall provide an operator console capable of interfacing with the ESPC trouble ticketing system.

sections.title: 3.4.1 Schedule Tasks
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of executing tasks according to a schedule.

sections.title: 3.4.2 Event Driven Tasks
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of executing tasks initiated by events.

sections.title: 3.4.3 Reliability of Scheduled Tasks
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of executing 99% of its scheduled tasks in any consecutive 30 day period.

sections.title: 3.4.4 Reliability of Event Driven Tasks
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of executing 99% of its event driven tasks in any consecutive 30 day period.

sections.title: 3.4.5 Adjust Priorities of Tasks
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of adjusting the priorities of scheduled and event-driven tasks.

sections.title: 3.5.1 Test Data Capacity
sections.text_preview: The System shall have the capacity to store 4 Terabytes (TBs) of data for testing purposes.

sections.title: 3.5.2 Metadata Standards Validation
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of reporting on all ingested, generated, and distributed data according to the (Federal Geographic Data Committee (FGDC) Content Standard for Digital Geospatial Metadata (C

sections.title: 3.5.3 Record Quality Information
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of storing product quality information in the metadata of products created.

sections.title: 3.5.4 NOAA-Unique Product Shelf Life
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of retaining Data Products for a configurable period of time not to exceed 96 hours.

sections.title: 3.6.1 Technology Updates
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of accepting technology updates without System downtime.

sections.title: 3.6.2 Scalability
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of adding additional capacity without redesign of it's infrastructure.

sections.title: 3.7.1 Follow ESPC Security Procedures
sections.text_preview: The System shall comply with ESPC (DoC/NOAA/NESDIS) procedures and policies as stated in the NOAA IT Security Manual 212-1300, Version 3.3, dated May 15, 2007.

sections.title: 3.7.2 Generate System Backups
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of generating backups for all NDE data, procedures, and software.

sections.title: 3.7.3 Identify Automated Backup Procedures
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of implementing automated backup procedures.

sections.title: 3.7.4 Restore from System Backups
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of returning to nominal operations following a restoration from system backups.

sections.title: 3.7.5 Integrity - Protect from Human Errors
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of protecting the integrity of NDE data in the event of human errors.

sections.title: 3.7.6 Integrity - Protect from Transmission Errors
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of protecting the integrity of NDE data in the event of computer to computer transmission errors.

sections.title: 3.7.7 Integrity - Protect from Software Bugs
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of protecting the integrity of NDE data from software bugs.

sections.title: 3.7.8 Integrity - Protect from Hardware Malfunction
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of protecting the integrity of NDE data in the event of a hardware malfunction such as a disk crash.

sections.title: 3.7.9 Integrity - Protect from Natural Disasters
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of protecting the integrity of NDE data in the event of a natural disaster.

sections.title: 3.7.10 ESPC Network Authorization
sections.text_preview: The NDE System can be accessed only with the authorization of the Government.

sections.title: 3.8.1.1 Hardware Reuse
sections.text_preview: The System shall be constructed using existing hardware where it is possible, practical, and approved by the Government. Inventory will be provided to the Contractor by OSDPD IT Lead.

sections.title: 3.8.2.1 Software Reuse
sections.text_preview: The System shall be constructed using existing software where it is possible, practical, and approved by the Government. Inventory will be provided to the Contractor by OSDPD IT Lead.

sections.title: 3.8.2.2 COTS and Open Source
sections.text_preview: The System shall be constructed using COTS and Open Source software where it is possible, practical, and approved by the Government.

sections.title: 3.8.2.3 Reusability
sections.text_preview: The NDE System Elements shall be designed to be reused in other Satellite Data Processing applications.

sections.title: 3.8.2.4 Modularity
sections.text_preview: The NDE System shall be designed so that Scientific Algorithms are invoked as objects.

sections.title: 3.9.1 Log and Track Events
sections.text_preview: The System shall provide the capability for operators to log and track events (i.e., MMC Service Requests, MMC Service Request Responses).

sections.title: 3.9.2 Provide an Operator Log
sections.text_preview: The System shall provide the capability for operators to update a summary log for the purposes of tracking the occurrence of significant events or activities.

sections.title: 3.9.3 Sort/Search Operator Log
sections.text_preview: The System shall provide the capability for operators to sort and search on summary log events for the purposes of identifying, troubleshooting, and reporting on significant activities.

sections.title: 3.9.4 Report on Events
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of reporting on summary log events.

sections.title: 3.9.5 Restart Procedures
sections.text_preview: The System shall provide the capability for operators to quiesce and restart the System. This capability should be designed to minimize interruptions of service.

sections.title: 3.9.6 Monitor Input Quality
sections.text_preview: The System shall implement operational quality monitoring procedures that will detect and report to operators and management the acceptability of xDR metadata according to configurable thresholds.

sections.title: 3.9.7 Monitor Output Quality
sections.text_preview:
The System shall implement operational quality monitoring procedures that will detect and report to operators and management the acceptability of output product metadata according to configurable

thr

sections.title: 3.9.8 Degraded Operations Notification
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of changing system status to reflect the condition of NPOESS (i.e., Degraded Operations, Restricted Access).

sections.title: 3.9.9 Archive System Elements
sections.text_preview: The System shall provide the capability for operators to forward NDE System Elements to CLASS for permanent archive.

sections.title: 3.10.1.1 Ingest Availability
sections.text_preview: The NDE Ingest capability shall not be interrupted for more than 2 hours in any consecutive 24 hour period and no more than 4 hours in any consecutive 30 day period.

sections.title: 3.10.1.2 Product Generation Availability
sections.text_preview: The NDE Product Generation capability shall not be interrupted for more than 2 hours in any consecutive 24 hour period and no more than 4 hours in any consecutive 30 day period.

sections.title: 3.10.1.3 Distribution Availability
sections.text_preview: The NDE Distribution capability shall not be interrupted for more than 2 hours in any consecutive 24 hour period and no more than 4 hours in any consecutive 30 day period.

sections.title: 3.10.1.4 Operations Monitoring Availability
sections.text_preview: The NDE Operations Monitoring capability shall not be interrupted for more than 2 hours in any consecutive 24 hour period and no more than 4 hours in any consecutive 30 day period.

sections.title: 3.10.1.5 Interruptions to Development
sections.text_preview: The Development and Maintenance Environment shall be available to at least 25 developers 85% of the time during normal business hours over any consecutive twelve month period. Normal business hours ar

sections.title: 3.10.2.1 IDPS Data Access Latency
sections.text_preview: The System shall be capable of accessing data delivered by IDPS within no more than ten seconds of notification from IDPS.

sections.title: 3.10.2.2 SARSAT Telemetry
sections.text_preview:
The System shall deliver SARSAT Telemetry data from IDPS to US Mission Control Center

(USMCC) within 1 minute of their receipt.

sections.title: 3.10.2.3 A-DCS Telemetry
sections.text_preview: The System shall deliver A-DCS Telemetry data from IDPS to the US Global Processing Center within 1 minute of their receipt.

sections.title: 3.10.2.4 A-DCS Data
sections.text_preview: The System shall deliver A-DCS Data Products from IDPS to the US Global Processing Center within 1 minute of their receipt.

sections.title: 3.10.3.1 NPP Era Product Volumes
sections.text_preview: During the NPP mission, the System shall be capable of supporting product volumes of 4 Terrabytes per day of input and 8 Terabytes per day of output.

sections.title: 3.10.3.2 NPOESS-C1 Era Product Volumes
sections.text_preview: During the NPOESS-C1 mission, the System shall be capable of supporting product volumes of 8 Terabytes per day of input and 16 Terrabytes per day of output.

sections.title: 3.10.3.3 NPOESS-C2 Era Product Volumes
sections.text_preview: During the NPOESS-C2 mission, the System shall be capable of supporting product volumes of 8 Terabytes per day of input and 16 Terabytes per day of output.

sections.title: 3.10.4 Federal Enterprise Architecture
sections.text_preview: The System shall be compliant with the OMB Federal Enterprise Architecture (FEA) according to the documents dated December 2006, and available from http://www.whitehouse.gov/omb/egov/a-2- EAModelsNEW2
